statement: For three strongly general smooth plane conics over a characteristic-zero field, the relatively oriented tangent-circle count in the Grothendieck–Witt group equals 92 hyperbolic planes. Its rank is 184. Over an algebraic closure this is the geometric degree H^2(6H-2E)^3 of the circle-tangency zero scheme on the blowup of P5 along the Veronese double-line locus.
